lines.text: The naira's name is hiding inside the word Nigeria.
On January first, 1973, Nigeria swapped the pound for brand new money: the naira.
The name is credited to Chief Obafemi Awolowo. He took it straight from Nigeria: Nai, ra.
And the kobo? Its name comes from the English word copper.
At the start, one pound was worth two naira.
